_about: Radio IDs -> rigs (the CAD's unit codes), seeded into state/cad.sqlite once per 'version' (sizeup/cad/radios.py).
After seeding, the Radios panel in the console is the place to change them: edits are kept and logged,
a new version here only adds IDs that aren't in the database yet (it never overwrites an edit).
system: 'mdc' = MDC-1200 PTT-ID heard on FG1 (4 hex digits, as decoded); 'p25' = county P25 radio ID.
source: confirmed (the department said so) | guessed (from a pattern, below) | heard (named on the air,
patterns: the user's guess (2026-10-07): new APX radios are <unit number>01-<unit number>10 (E63 -> 6301-6310),
old radios are 0<unit number>1-0<unit number>9 (E61 -> 0611-0619). Applied to PCFD's own units of the
kinds listed; an ID two units would both get is left unmapped and listed as a conflict, and a unit whose
number doesn't give a 4-digit ID (TL2, U239, the chiefs) is listed as not fitting.
